concept: ElastiCache: cache for hot reads in front of the DB
tests: Choosing a separate scalable read layer for frequently requested, rarely changing data.
expected: ElastiCache (in-memory cache) in front of the relational DB. Triggers: "sub-millisecond reads", "frequently requested, rarely changing data", "reference data", "high read load".
why_not: Extra indexes speed up individual queries but do not provide a scalable layer and slow down writes; strong consistency adds cost/latency without more throughput; scaling up the DB hits a ceiling.
